title: Analysis code for: Multi-tissue mRNA-seq, miRNA-seq and single-cell RNA-seq data from heat-stressed lactating Holstein cows
description:
Analysis and figure code for the Scientific Data Descriptor "Multi-tissue mRNA-seq, miRNA-seq and single-cell RNA-seq data from heat-stressed lactating Holstein cows".

  • SciData_Master_RCode_Final.R — main analysis and figure script. Starting from the compiled bulk count matrix and from the archived intermediate objects of the original analysis, it produces the differential-expression summaries (Fig. 2), GO/KEGG enrichment (Fig. 3), miRNA target networks (Fig. 4), re-clustering, SingleR annotation and cell-type-resolved comparisons (Fig. 5), hdWGCNA co-expression modules (Fig. 6a-c) and CellChat cell-cell communication (Fig. 6d).
  • figures/ — scripts that rendered the final submitted versions of Fig. 2c, Fig. 3, Fig. 5a-d and Fig. 6b.
  • SciData_Figure_RCode_final.R — earlier partial figure collection; superseded for the panels under figures/.
  • run_dnbc4tools_all.sh — scRNA-seq upstream processing (DNBC4tools v2.1.3) for the six PBMC libraries.
  • sessionInfo.txt — full R session and package versions.

Steps not re-executed by this code: bulk read alignment and counting (FASTQ to count matrix), performed by the sequencing provider with HISAT2 v2.0.4 and StringTie v1.3.1; the original tissue-level DESeq2 differential-expression run; the miRNA target prediction (TargetScan, miRWalk); and the initial anchor-based single-cell integration. The script reads the archived result objects of those steps as inputs - see "What this code does and does not run" in the README.

Associated data: GEO accession GSE338587; figshare doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.32993768.
